item.title: mibee-eye-notebook's Multimodal AI: How Nine Local Models Divide the Work, and How It Compares
item.description: The previous two surveys covered full-modal interaction — seeing, hearing, speaking, turn-taking, acting — from both the model and pipeline angles. This post lands on practice: what mibee-eye-notebook (below: notebook) is attempting is exactly running that multi-model cooperation approach inside one Rust project. First a breakdown of how it combines its models, then a comparison with a batch of open-source projects heading the same direction — where they converge, and where each makes different trade-offs.
